description: For every accepted row of a quantifier-free ground formula \(A\), its specified positive-relation model satisfies that exact formula, is finite, and has at most one plus the number of distinct subterms of \(A\) elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.passing_row_model.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)] (A : L.Sentence)
  (hA : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF A)
  (r :
    ↥(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A)) →
      Bool)
  (hb :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.extendRow
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A))
          r)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A) =
      true)
  (hc :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.literalTest
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.rowProblem
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A))
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.extendRow
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A))
            r)) =
      true) :
  have Γ :=
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.rowProblem
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A))
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.extendRow
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A))
        r);
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Carrier Γ ⊨ A ∧
    Finite (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Carrier Γ) ∧
      Nat.card (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Carrier Γ) ≤
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.formulaSupport A).card + 1
